definitions.label: Free throws
definitions.definition: Free throws made divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Rim finishing
definitions.definition: Made field goals at the rim divided by attempts at the rim.

definitions.label: Short midrange
definitions.definition: Short-midrange makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Long midrange
definitions.definition: Long-midrange makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Corner three
definitions.definition: Corner-three makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Above-break three
definitions.definition: Above-break three-point makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Three-point shooting
definitions.definition: All three-point makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Catch-and-shoot three
definitions.definition: Catch-and-shoot three-point makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Pull-up three
definitions.definition: Pull-up three-point makes divided by attempts.

definitions.label: Shot quality
definitions.definition: Expected points per attempt from defender-distance and two-versus-three-point shot mix.

definitions.label: Shotmaking
definitions.definition: Realized points above the player-neutral shot expectation per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: zTS
definitions.definition: True-shooting percentage minus the expectation from the player's playtype mix.

definitions.label: Assist creation
definitions.definition: Points created by assists per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: Potential assists
definitions.definition: Potential assists per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: Rim assists
definitions.definition: Assists on rim attempts per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: Three-point assists
definitions.definition: Assists on corner and above-break threes per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: Passing efficiency
definitions.definition: Assist points created per potential assist.

definitions.label: Ball security
definitions.definition: Turnovers divided by shooting, free-throw and turnover usage events.

definitions.label: Live-ball security
definitions.definition: Live-ball turnovers divided by shooting, free-throw and turnover usage events.

definitions.label: Drive creation
definitions.definition: Assists created per 100 drives.

definitions.label: Rim pressure
definitions.definition: Rim attempts per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: Free-throw pressure
definitions.definition: Free-throw attempts per 100 offensive possessions.

definitions.label: Offensive load
definitions.definition: The public Offensive Load composite in the statistical feature panel.

definitions.label: Offensive rebounding
definitions.definition: Offensive rebounds per recorded offensive rebound chance; scored as a rate because source counts are not bounded binomial trials.

definitions.label: Defensive rebounding
definitions.definition: Defensive rebounds per recorded defensive rebound chance; scored as a rate because source counts are not bounded binomial trials.

definitions.label: Contested rebounding
definitions.definition: Contested rebounds secured per recorded rebound chance; an available-data proxy for contested conversion.

definitions.label: Rim deterrence
definitions.definition: Season-average rim attempts faced per 100 minus the player's observed rate; positive means fewer rim attempts faced.

definitions.label: Rim points saved
definitions.definition: Estimated rim points saved per 100 defensive possessions from observed rim shot defense.

definitions.label: Non-rim suppression
definitions.definition: Season-average non-rim attempts faced per 100 minus the player's observed rate; an observational suppression proxy.

definitions.label: Matchup points saved
definitions.definition: Opponent-adjusted points saved per 100 assigned matchup possessions, already source-level EB shrunk.

definitions.label: Turnovers forced
definitions.definition: Turnovers forced versus scorer expectation per 100 assigned matchup possessions.

definitions.label: Foul discipline
definitions.definition: Shooting fouls prevented versus scorer expectation per 100 assigned matchup possessions.

definitions.label: Deflections
definitions.definition: Deflections per 100 defensive possessions.

definitions.label: Recovered blocks
definitions.definition: Blocks recovered by the defense per 100 defensive possessions.
